title: SlugBleed, DSFFAKW, Rat Kingdom @ BOX BOY VINTAGE
seo_title: SlugBleed, DSFFAKW, Rat Kingdom at Box Boy Vintage
description: A live music night at Box Boy Vintage featuring Alabama Slam band SlugBleed, Deep Sea Fishing For A Killer Whale, and Rat Kingdom, held to support SlugBleed as they play shows across the country. The show is all ages, with admission at $5 or pay what you can. It takes place Sunday, November 29, 2026 at 6:30 PM at 1619 S Main Street in Joplin, Missouri.
